description: Workspace packages as nodes and internal dependencies (`"utils": "workspace:*"`) as edges. It must be acyclic.
Rules relating tasks: `"dependsOn": ["^build"]` runs the `build` of every dependency first; `"build"` without the caret runs the package's own `build` first.
Level 0 holds packages without dependencies; every other package sits one level above its deepest dependency. A level can run in parallel.
The packages owning a changed file plus every package that depends on them, transitively (`nx affected`, `turbo run --affected`).
A cache key computed from a task's inputs: source files, dependency hashes, task configuration, declared environment variables and global files.
Skipping a task whose hash was seen before and restoring its declared `outputs` and logs, locally or from a remote cache.
Files outside every package (root lockfile, base `tsconfig`) that invalidate every task when they change.
